description: Le réseau routier de la Ville d'Esch-sur-Alzette is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville d'Esch-sur-Alzette. The portal shows the English title as "The road network of the City of Esch-sur-Alzette" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville d'Esch-sur-Alzette. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
